title: Launching of 115th Round of Quarterly Industrial Outlook Survey (IOS) - Q2:2026-27
description: The Reserve Bank has launched the 115th round of the quarterly Industrial Outlook Survey (IOS) of the Indian manufacturing sector for the reference period July - September 2026. The survey assesses business sentiments for the current quarter (Q2:2026-27) and expectations for the ensuing quarter (Q3:2026-27), based on qualitative responses on a set of indicators pertaining to demand conditions, financial conditions, employment conditions and the price situation.
